scope: Original scientific Issue #1: preserve LLM generalization while identifying non-degrading deterministic EC replacements
question: Can the NL→EC formal rule handoff be independently checked without requiring handwritten answer mappings?

evaluated_prior_art.name: Attempto Controlled English/APE
evaluated_prior_art.method: Controlled English grammar parsed to Discourse Representation Structures and formal outputs including FOL/RuleML
evaluated_prior_art.reuse: Potential independently authored controlled requirement specification, requiring SWI-Prolog and language/domain vocabulary approval
evaluated_prior_art.does_not_prove: Ordinary arbitrary English policy equivalence or independent custody by parsing itself

evaluated_prior_art.name: IBM NL2LTL
evaluated_prior_art.method: Natural language→LTL translation with model/intent engines and formula filter
evaluated_prior_art.reuse: Possible later temporal obligation requirement formalization if protocol gains LTL
evaluated_prior_art.does_not_prove: NL intent fidelity or non-temporal current policy semantics

evaluated_prior_art.name: Open Policy Agent / Conftest
evaluated_prior_art.method: Regulated policy-as-code and repeatable tests with Rego data/policy separation
evaluated_prior_art.reuse: Independent formal policy test corpus after EC Boolean rule admission, Rego cross-engine later if needed
evaluated_prior_art.does_not_prove: Correct translation of unstructured insurance wording

evaluated_prior_art.name: SymPy SAT
evaluated_prior_art.method: Symbolic propositional expressions and satisfiable(Xor(reference, candidate)) counterexample
evaluated_prior_art.reuse: DIRECTLY_INTEGRATED, no reimplementation of solver; exact EC v2 fact/not:fact AND grammar
evaluated_prior_art.does_not_prove: Independent authority of reference formula or accuracy of NL→formal conversion

evaluated_prior_art.name: FormalBench (ACL 2025)
evaluated_prior_art.method: Executability and semantics evaluated separately, metamorphic semantic-preserving controls
evaluated_prior_art.reuse: Counterfactual negative controls and strict proof boundaries, no model weights imported
evaluated_prior_art.does_not_prove: This benchmark's label authority or task transfer reliability

evaluated_prior_art.name: Postcondition Formalization Benchmark (2026)
evaluated_prior_art.method: Automatically generated tests reveal incorrectly formalized postconditions; no evaluated LLM correct on every task
evaluated_prior_art.reuse: Non-target test generator and counterexample-driven repair with independent reference
evaluated_prior_art.does_not_prove: Generated tests alone are complete NL semantics certificates

supported_checks: unmodified or reordered AND rules prove equivalent
negation or omitted condition yield SAT witness
duplicate JSON keys and private gold reject
source identity and source SHA pin checked
unknown observations never fabricated as false

root_cause_refinement.before: Formal operation_rules absent, human NL rule truth unavailable; P01 10/10 fails formal handoff.
root_cause_refinement.after: Independent *formal policy* equivalence and counterexamples solved with existing SAT library. NL interpretation→independently approved formal reference remains unresolved. Keeping exact structural scope avoids both oracle laundering and overspecifying a new model as necessary.
root_cause_refinement.next_critical_dependency: Obtain genuinely independently authored, source-custodied policy clauses + fact vocabulary for matched test tasks; freeze before model candidate; use this SAT oracle on proposals, then native EC v2 with S3/S4 same-function paired model; no false assumption 10 synthetic development cases are independent holdout.
